name.en-US: On Prayer: Spiritual Instructions in the Form of Dialogues on the Various States of Prayer
name.pt-BR: Sobre a oração: instruções espirituais em forma de diálogos sobre os diversos estados de oração

description.en-US: The only book Jean-Pierre de Caussade, S.J. (1675-1751) published in his lifetime (Perpignan, 1741, anonymously): a set of dialogues, in question and answer, on the states of prayer according to Bossuet’s Instruction sur les divers états d’oraison. Book I defends the true mystics against the Quietist errors, drawing on Bossuet, Francis de Sales and Jane de Chantal; Book II teaches the practice, the four purities, the rules of recollection, and advice for beginners, the advanced and those far on. Algar Thorold’s English of 1931 from the 1892-95 French text, with the Abbot of Downside’s (Dom John Chapman’s) Introduction, Thorold’s Note and Fr. Ludovic de Besse’s Preface. The French text could not be found in a clean edition, so this book has the English only.
description.pt-BR: O único livro que Jean-Pierre de Caussade, S.J. (1675-1751) publicou em vida (Perpignan, 1741, anonimamente): diálogos em perguntas e respostas sobre os estados de oração segundo a Instruction sur les divers états d’oraison de Bossuet. O Livro I defende os verdadeiros místicos contra os erros quietistas; o Livro II ensina a prática, as quatro purezas, as regras do recolhimento e conselhos para principiantes e adiantados. Tradução inglesa de Algar Thorold (1931), com a introdução de Dom John Chapman, a nota do tradutor e o prefácio de Ludovic de Besse. O texto francês não foi encontrado em edição limpa.

sources.edition: Jean-Pierre de Caussade, On Prayer: Spiritual Instructions in the form of Dialogues on the various States of Prayer according to the doctrine of Bossuet, Bishop of Meaux, translated by Algar Thorold from the Bussenot text (Reims, 1892-95) of the Perpignan 1741 edition, with an Introduction by the Abbot of Downside and a Preface by Fr. Ludovic de Besse, London: Burns Oates & Washbourne, 1931. Internet Archive scan, OCR text.
sources.description: Introduction, Translator’s Note, Preface, and both Books (Book I: preliminary dialogue and sixteen dialogues; Book II: preliminary dialogue and ten dialogues, with the closing prayer) with the translator’s footnotes. The contents tables, the Bossuet appendix and the printer’s matter are left out. OCR corrected only by script: running heads and page numbers stripped, hyphenation rejoined, question and answer marks normalised, footnotes tied to their markers by page; quotation marks misread as digits or "£", some footnote markers and the notes that continue over a page remain imperfect, and one upside-down page in Book I, Dialogue XI is lost.
sources.tierEvidence: Published London 1931, imprimatur 27 April 1931; Thorold died in 1936 and Chapman in 1933, so the text is public domain by the death rule. Caussade died in 1751.
